what:
Follow-up of 01455: share std across BLAZE_HOMEs on one machine, keyed by blaze's own build. Needs the multi-writer store queued alongside (blaze-cas).

(1) Build id: at start the daemon hashes its own executable (`std::env::current_exe()` bytes, BLAKE3 domain "blaze v2 build id 1") into `Options::build: ContentId`, then `Setup::build`. No version string: a dirty self-build tree keeps its commit. A failure to read the executable is a start error, never a skipped share.
(2) Machine std dir: serve.rs gains `pub fn machine() -> anyhow::Result<PathBuf>`: `XDG_CACHE_HOME/blaze`, else `~/.cache/blaze`, ignoring BLAZE_HOME and erroring as `state()` does. `Setup::std` becomes `<machine>/std/<build id hex>`, so BuildConfig::std and every std unit's outputs are `<machine>/std/<build>/<StdKey id>/...`. Two daemons of one build write the same bytes to one path. Placement is an atomic rename, so a race is two equal writes; a test should check it.
(3) Std records: compile.rs/codegen.rs look up and write a std unit's record (`unit.is_std`) and its artifacts in the machine std store `<machine>/std/<build>/store` (the blaze-cas item), the rest in the home's store as now. The record key is unchanged: the build id is in the store's path.
(4) Tests: serve/tests.rs, two sim daemons with separate state dirs and one machine dir, where the second compiles no std unit. Extend repro 01458 with a second BLAZE_HOME for the same property: `a_second_blaze_home_compiles_no_std_crate`.
